title: Account for impairment of property, plant, and equipment

items.concept: Purchase (initial recognition); pre-impairment depreciation; period-end impairment adjusting JE (recoverability + measurement); subsequent depreciation schedule; disposal after impairment
Number-variant twin — purchase; recoverability; period-end impairment adjusting JE; subsequent depreciation schedule; disposal with gain
Period-end multi-asset recoverability (some pass); combined impairment adjusting JE only for failed assets; subsequent dep on written-down asset; disclosure
Recoverability uses undiscounted cash flows; impairment loss measured with fair value
New cost basis after period-end impairment; restoration prohibited for PPE held for use
